t: Introduction and overview — Sejong the Great-class Destroyer
name: Introduction and overview — Sejong the Great-class Destroyer — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Sejong the Great-class Destroyer
description: Introduction and overview of the Sejong the Great-class Destroyer: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. South Korea's Sejong the Great class — three ships, among the largest Aegis destroyers in the world at 11,000 tons — carries 128 vertical-launch cells (Korean and U.S. types) plus ballistic-missile-defense capability. The class anchors the ROK Navy's blue-water ambitions. Baseline facts: South Korean Aegis destroyer; 3 built; 128 VLS cells; ballistic-missile defense..
